violations.text: Working spray bottle containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. Sprayer bottles are to be labeled with the chemical they contain. New Violation. Correct By: 10/28/2026

Opened bags of flour and salt were observed stored in the basement area without protection from possible contamination from the premises. Opened bags are to be stored in containers to seal and protect the food ingredient from possible contamination. New Violation. Correct By: 10/28/2026

The non-food-contact surfaces of the doors and door tracks to the sliding door cooler unit have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment are to be cleaned at a frequency necessary to keep them clean and preclude the buildup of soil and debris. New Violation. Correct By: 10/28/2026

The floor in the basement area of the facility was observed to have an accumulation of soil residue, debris, and old droppings under and behind shelving and equipment. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 10/28/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the basement area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary equipment and old single-use items to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 01/31/2027
